nodes.label: Madsen Cycles
nodes.rationale: Madsen Cycles is the Shopify-based cargo and utility bicycle e-commerce store operating at madsencycles.com. Specializes in family bucket bikes (DK2 models) carrying up to 600 lbs / 4 kids. Offers electric and non-electric variants.

nodes.label: Affirm Buy-Now-Pay-Later
nodes.rationale: Affirm.js v2 integrated on every page as the primary financing/payment-plan provider. Public API key X9AULLFW3B9LF8ZI. Offers 0% APR OAC or 10-36% APR over 6/12/36 months. Referenced explicitly in payment-plan and payment-plans-new pages.

nodes.label: Shopify Focal Theme
nodes.rationale: Storefront runs the 'Focal' Shopify theme (P3 July28/2024 version), deployed 04.08.2023. Theme CSS at theme.css?v=22739560170823345021691129493, JS at theme.js?v=15382823470713337961691129493.

nodes.label: Pandectes GDPR Consent Management
nodes.rationale: Pandectes GDPR app active with store ID 227402, plan 'basic'. Supports 22+ language locales. Cookie consent banner displayed on all pages. Manages manual blacklist categories for scripts, iframes, CSS, and beacons.

nodes.label: Pixel.ad Tracking
nodes.rationale: Pixel.ad up.js script loaded on all pages with cntrData tracking ID db6d243ceaeaf604. Used for audience targeting and conversion tracking.

nodes.label: Shopify Storefront
nodes.rationale: Shopify-powered e-commerce store using trekkie.storefront.min.js (Shopify's customer tracking). Product reviews via shopifycdn.com. Payment methods include VISA, MasterCard, Discover, Amazon Pay, PayPal, and Affirm.
